## The policy baseline

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `codeflow policy baseline show` | Prints the record and how it bears on the policy read. Read only; runs anywhere. |
| `codeflow policy baseline init` | Asks the remote for its default branch and commit (`git ls-remote --symref`), fetches that commit's objects without writing a ref, and prints the commit and policy digest. With `--confirm <commit>` it writes the record. |
| `codeflow policy baseline refresh` | The same read, then moves the record to a commit that descends from the recorded one with a policy no weaker. Anything else needs `--reset --reason <text>`, which is recorded. |

| State | Policy enforced |
|---|---|
| the tracking ref is at the recorded commit | unchanged |
| the ref descends from the recorded commit | the stricter of the two; doctor names the refresh |
| the ref does not descend from it | the baseline's |
| the remote is gone, or advertises no refs | the baseline's; doctor names the removed remote |
| no record, and the ledger does not list the repository | unchanged; doctor notes that none is recorded |
| the ledger lists the repository but the record is gone, the record cannot be read, is writable by others, fails its digest, or names another repository, remote URL or default branch | none: the policy check blocks until the operator repairs it |

## When a hook is skipped

| Skipped stage | What still applies locally | What stops a forced update or deletion on the remote |
|---|---|---|
| Commit hooks | With the reference hook still installed and `git.local_ref_protection` set to `block`, it refuses the new commit's local ref move. The reference hook also judges other local protected-ref moves and deletions under their policy levels; an exact remote-head sync remains allowed. | The remote host's protection applies to any later push. Local refusal is no evidence of those host rules. |
| Push hook | The reference hook judges local ref transactions, not the remote destination. A push need not move the local branch. | Only the remote's protection. Without it, no local layer refuses this remote change once the push hook is skipped. |

## Git hook stages

<!-- codeflow-hook-stages begin -->

| Stage | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `pre-commit` | a |
| `commit-msg` | b |
| `pre-merge-commit` | c |
| `reference-transaction` | d |
| `pre-push` | e |

<!-- codeflow-hook-stages end -->
